# Spike fixtures

Raw Web API responses from the Phase 0 spike against the `naleidworkspace` test workspace on 2026-10-19 (see `docs/specs/phase0-spike-findings.md`). They are verbatim except: emails end in `@example.invalid`, and in the two snippet `files.info.*.json` files `content` is cut to its first 20 lines and `content_highlight_html`/`content_highlight_css` are replaced by a placeholder. They are superseded by fixtures recorded with `just record-fixtures`.
